title: Rafael and the Protocol
author: Freya Winterbourne
blurb: Freya Sandoval, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
